view: Old Oyo Nigeria ruined earthen city wall gateway, ground-level view of eroded low mud-block banks flanking narrow passage, scattered laterite stones and grass with savanna woodland behind, subtle archaeological earthworks not stone castle, no intact palace or invented sculptural gate.

eras.title: An opening in the earthworks
eras.caption: Old Oyo's walls enclosed a large Yoruba capital, with further defensive circuits beyond the palace area. Eroded banks, gateways and traces of wells preserve its layout within a landscape now covered by grass and woodland.
